name: socialmidi
tagline: ClockBox v3 MIDI master clock on the FM-1
description: ClockBox v3 (github.com/Andymann/clockbox-v3) on the FM-1: a 24 PPQN MIDI master clock over USB and Bluetooth MIDI with Quantized Restart, follow modes for clock from the TRS jack or USB, tap tempo, three tempo presets that jump or fade, and a sync pulse on the audio out.
